message.content: On September 16, 2026, during their conversation about the TV series "Westworld," LiHua expressed enthusiasm for the concept of improvisation. He stated, "I totally agree! His search for meaning and pushing boundaries makes him really intriguing. It’s fascinating how his past affects his actions. Those layers add so much depth to the story. Do you have a favorite moment of his?" and "Yeah, that moment when he shows vulnerability really struck me! It added a whole new perspective to his character. I also liked the interactions he had with other characters—it was so intense and gripping!" These comments indicate that LiHua finds the idea of improvisation intriguing and believes it adds depth to the character development. He also highlights how improvisation can lead to unexpected and compelling moments in the story.
